changes.text:
ClearTax removed as a source; EU ViDA (1 Jul 2030) entry removed with it.
92 milestones across 32 countries.

Tracker started from the einvoice.global calendar (source dated 04 Oct 2026).
92 milestones across 32 countries.

milestones.title: Receive obligation
milestones.detail: All domestic B2B taxable persons must be able to receive structured e-invoices.

milestones.title: Transition allowance
milestones.detail: Paper and PDF still permitted with recipient consent.

milestones.title: Coretax migration
milestones.detail: DJP migrates to Coretax Administration System, the new portal for VAT and e-Faktur. Certificates re-issued; some H2H endpoints updated.

milestones.title: Phase 2, upper mid-market
milestones.detail: Annual turnover RM25M to RM100M.

milestones.title: B2C all
milestones.detail: All domestic B2C.

milestones.title: 30-day reporting window
milestones.detail: Invoices must be reported to IRP within 30 days from invoice date.

milestones.title: FatturaPA v1.9
milestones.detail: New TD29 notification, RF20 regime, refined controls.

milestones.title: Soft launch, new voluntary registrants
milestones.detail: Voluntary participation begins.

milestones.title: HMRC consultation closed
milestones.detail: HMRC and DBT joint consultation on the UK regime closed.

milestones.title: PINT A-NZ sole format
milestones.detail: PINT A-NZ replaces PEPPOL BIS 3.0 A-NZ as sole supported format.

milestones.title: B2B mandate, large
milestones.detail: Large enterprises must issue full e-invoices.

milestones.title: Phase 3, mid-market
milestones.detail: Annual turnover RM5M to RM25M.

milestones.title: Phase 1, large taxpayers
milestones.detail: Large taxpayers live on MBS; compliance deadline 31 Jul 2026.

milestones.title: GTA pilot, selected large entities
milestones.detail: Voluntary pilot with selected large taxpayers on the GTA platform.

milestones.title: Budget 2025 confirms 2029 mandate
milestones.detail: Mandatory B2B and B2G e-invoicing for VAT invoices from 1 Apr 2029.

milestones.title: Draft Data Dictionary circulated
milestones.detail: OTA shared first technical requirements with selected taxpayers.

milestones.title: Phase 2 Wave 22
milestones.detail: Wave 22 integration deadline.

milestones.title: B2B mandate
milestones.detail: All domestic B2B between Belgian VAT-registered persons via Peppol.

milestones.title: National NFS-e mandatory
milestones.detail: All municipalities except Sao Paulo migrate to national standard.

milestones.title: IBS/CBS/IS fields operational
milestones.detail: Tax reform layout with new tax groups via Technical Note 2024.001.

milestones.title: VAT Law in force, e-fapiao sole format
milestones.detail: e-fapiao is the only legal invoice format; delivery via digital tax accounts.

milestones.title: Fiskalizacija 2.0
milestones.detail: Mandatory B2B e-invoicing plus real-time fiscalisation and e-reporting for VAT-registered residents.

milestones.title: Digital bookkeeping above DKK 300k
milestones.detail: Extends to all businesses with turnover above DKK 300,000, including custom systems.

milestones.title: Phase 4, SMEs
milestones.detail: Now RM3M to RM5M turnover (narrowed 1 Sep 2026). Penalty-free relaxation until 31 Dec 2027.

milestones.title: 2026 tax reform, abbreviated verification
milestones.detail: SAT can declare CFDIs false; criminal liability for invoice fraud.

milestones.title: Cancellation extended to ISR return
milestones.detail: CFDI cancellation deadline extended to month of annual ISR filing.

milestones.title: Digital platforms complement Rev E
milestones.detail: New complement for platform economy reporting.

milestones.title: Wave 3, all large taxpayers
milestones.detail: Full LTS coverage.

milestones.title: Non-resident VAT customers
milestones.detail: Invoices to non-resident VAT-registered customers via e-Factura within 5 working days.

milestones.title: Stakeholder co-design phase
milestones.detail: HMRC and DBT begin detailed design collaboration.

milestones.title: Sandbox live
milestones.detail: OTA sandbox live; ASPs and large taxpayers begin integration testing.

milestones.title: Mandatory, large taxpayers
milestones.detail: Large VAT taxpayers must issue via KSeF 2.0.

milestones.title: B2B mandate proposed
milestones.detail: Proposed domestic B2B mandate from 1 Jan 2030 (ViDA DRR aligned), EN 16931.

milestones.title: Phase 2 Wave 23
milestones.detail: Wave 23 integration deadline.

milestones.title: Penalties active
milestones.detail: Grace period ends; fines EUR 1,500 to 5,000.

milestones.title: PINT-OM specification published
milestones.detail: Covers invoices, credit notes, self-billing and Tax Data Documents.

milestones.title: Mandatory, all VAT
milestones.detail: All other VAT-registered taxpayers.

milestones.title: All new voluntary GST registrants
milestones.detail: Mandatory for newly incorporated voluntary registrants.

milestones.title: ASP registration portal opens
milestones.detail: ASP paid-up capital cut from OMR 60,000 to OMR 6,000.

milestones.title: Draft law approved
milestones.detail: Approved by Council of Ministers; not yet gazetted, so no obligation binds.

milestones.title: Peppol confirmed as core network
milestones.detail: Ministerial statement names Peppol as the UK interoperability network.

milestones.title: Voluntary exchange in production
milestones.detail: About 5,000 companies exchanging voluntarily.

milestones.title: Phase 2 Wave 24
milestones.detail: Wave 24 integration deadline.

milestones.title: 30% Peppol target
milestones.detail: Target: 30% of supplier invoices to non-corporates via Peppol.

milestones.title: Expected wave 1, above BHD 1m
milestones.detail: Indicated, not enacted. Date passed without taking effect; programme has slipped.

milestones.title: Phase 2, medium taxpayers
milestones.detail: Medium taxpayers live; enforcement Jan to Mar 2027.

milestones.title: Pilot phase
milestones.detail: Pilot under FTA supervision with selected stakeholders and accredited ASPs. Others may adopt voluntarily.

milestones.title: Bill 8815 approved by government
milestones.detail: Phased domestic B2B e-invoicing draft law approved; not yet enacted.

milestones.title: Phase 1, top ~100 large taxpayers
milestones.detail: Notified large taxpayers must issue via accredited ASPs.

milestones.title: Phase 1, issue + receive + e-reporting
milestones.detail: Issue obligation begins; all businesses must be able to receive.

milestones.title: Exemption threshold raised to RM3M
milestones.detail: MSMEs below RM3M permanently exempt (Guideline v4.8).

milestones.title: Small-business paper relief ends
milestones.detail: Small businesses must now issue through KSeF.

milestones.title: Transitional ITC (50%)
milestones.detail: 50% input tax credit for unregistered suppliers.

milestones.title: No mandate announced
milestones.detail: No obligation exists; VAT not yet implemented.

milestones.title: ASP appointment deadline (extended)
milestones.detail: Taxpayers with revenue of AED 50M or more must appoint an MoF-accredited ASP via EmaraTax.

milestones.title: Implementation roadmap (Budget 2026)
milestones.detail: Full roadmap and technical standards to be published.

milestones.title: B2B mandate, second period
milestones.detail: Smaller enterprises begin; mixed systems allowed until 31 Jan 2027.

milestones.title: NF-e for non-ICMS IBS/CBS taxpayers
milestones.detail: New NF-e model becomes mandatory (Joint Act RFB/CGIBS 4/2026).

milestones.title: Full automation target
milestones.detail: Full e-invoicing automation across Commonwealth.

milestones.title: Full B2B coverage
milestones.detail: Mandatory structured e-invoices and receipts for covered taxpayers (RR 26-2025).

milestones.title: Offline mode relief ends
milestones.detail: From 2027 an invoice not delivered to KSeF is not valid.

milestones.title: Expected wave 2, above BHD 500k
milestones.detail: Expected, not legislated; wave 1 already slipped.

milestones.title: Issue obligation, large
milestones.detail: Issuers above threshold must send EN 16931-compliant invoices.

milestones.title: e-Delivery Phase B
milestones.detail: Loading, transshipment and receipt data mandatory. Postponed from 12 Oct 2026.

milestones.title: B2B issuance mandate
milestones.detail: EHF 3.0 e-invoices for domestic B2B where recipient is in ELMA.

milestones.title: Mandatory, micro
milestones.detail: Smallest taxpayers join KSeF.

milestones.title: Expected go-live
milestones.detail: Staggered rollout by size. Not legislated; depends on gazettal.

milestones.title: Mandatory B2B and B2G
milestones.detail: All Slovak VAT taxpayers issue and receive structured e-invoices.

milestones.title: Verifactu, Corp Tax payers
milestones.detail: Certified billing software (SIF) mandatory.

milestones.title: Wave 1, large taxpayers
milestones.detail: Mandatory B2B and B2G e-invoicing via Peppol 5-corner / DCTCE.

milestones.title: B2B, accredited providers only
milestones.detail: Transition ends for second-period businesses.

milestones.title: Phase 2 Wave 25
milestones.detail: Threshold halved from Wave 24's SAR 375k. ZATCA notifies directly.

milestones.title: Next phase (deferred)
milestones.detail: Next stage of digital bookkeeping; single Peppol spec planned by mid-2028.

milestones.title: ASP appointment deadline, below AED 50M
milestones.detail: Taxpayers below AED 50M revenue must appoint an MoF-accredited ASP.

milestones.title: Wave 1, supplies above OMR 5m
milestones.detail: Statutory deadline under Decision 189/2026.

milestones.title: Phase 3, small and emerging
milestones.detail: Remaining taxpayers live; enforcement Jan to Mar 2028.

milestones.title: Verifactu, others
milestones.detail: Self-employed and other VAT taxpayers.

milestones.title: Wave 2, all other businesses
milestones.detail: All VAT-registered businesses regardless of revenue.

milestones.title: Phase 2, SMEs and TPEs
milestones.detail: Issue obligation extends to all remaining VAT-registered businesses.

milestones.title: Wave 2, at or below OMR 5m
milestones.detail: All remaining VAT-registered persons in scope.

milestones.title: Crea y Crece B2B (large)
milestones.detail: Turnover above EUR 8M. Ministerial Order still pending, may move.

milestones.title: Wave 3, government
milestones.detail: Government departments and federal entities in scope.

milestones.title: Phase 4 relaxation ends
milestones.detail: Penalty-free period ends (Guideline v4.7).

milestones.title: E-Reporting (DRR)
milestones.detail: Near-real-time e-reporting, aligned with EU ViDA.

milestones.title: Issue obligation, all B2B
milestones.detail: All B2B issuers must send structured e-invoices.

milestones.title: TARIC product classification
milestones.detail: TARIC-based product coding mandatory. Postponed from 1 Jan 2027.

milestones.title: B2B receive obligation
milestones.detail: All in-scope businesses must be able to receive.

milestones.title: Full enforcement
milestones.detail: Section 120 penalties RM200 to 20,000 per non-compliant invoice.

milestones.title: Penalties begin
milestones.detail: Deferred from 1 Jan 2027; KSeF obligation itself unchanged.

milestones.title: New compulsory + smaller existing
milestones.detail: Phased extension to existing registrants.

milestones.title: B2B issue, large and medium
milestones.detail: Large and medium businesses must issue structured e-invoices.

milestones.title: Crea y Crece B2B (all)
milestones.detail: SMEs, sole traders and the rest. Gated on the same pending Order.
